justification: Both show the same distinctive scheme of a boat with upturned terminals carrying standing schematic crew figures, drawn as solid infilled silhouettes with blob heads and stick limbs, and A also contains groups of similar armed stick figures plus dot/cup-like marks. The main difference is scope and density: A is a wide multi-figure panel with weapon-bearing groups and processional arrangement, while B isolates a single two-crew boat at large scale with no surrounding figures.
